headline: Earnings jump on favorable one-offs; guidance raised
summary_short: 3M's Q2 FY2026 GAAP EPS of $1.78 rose 33% y/y as sales grew 2.4% to $6.5B, while adjusted EPS of $2.40 rose 11% y/y and 3M raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $8.80-$8.95.
summary_long: GAAP EPS of $1.78 rose 33% y/y (net income $933M, +29%) as a favorable swing in the Solventum stake value (+$0.60/share) and lower PFAS/litigation costs (-$0.44/share vs -$0.79/share a year ago) more than offset a $336M loss on the Dyneon divestiture and $100M of transformation costs; adjusted EPS was $2.40, +11% y/y. Sales rose 2.4% to $6.5B (organic +2.3%; adjusted organic +5.4%), led by Safety and Industrial (+8.2% organic) while Consumer sales fell. GAAP operating margin fell 290bps to 15.1% on the divestiture charge, though adjusted operating margin expanded 40bps to 24.9%. Cash fell to $2.96B from $5.24B at year-end on $3.8B of dividends/buybacks and PFAS payments. 3M raised FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $8.80-$8.95 from $8.50-$8.70.

drivers.explanation: GAAP operating margin fell 290bps y/y to 15.1%, driven by a $336M loss on the Dyneon GmbH divestiture, $100M of transformation costs, and $12M of acquisition-related costs; adjusted operating margin rose 40bps to 24.9% excluding these items.

GAAP EPS rose 33% y/y mainly on a $0.60/share favorable swing in the value of 3M's retained Solventum stake and lower net PFAS/litigation costs ($0.44/share vs $0.79/share a year ago), partly offset by the $0.61/share divestiture loss.
Organic sales rose 2.3% y/y (adjusted organic +5.4%), led by Safety and Industrial (+8.2% organic) and Transportation and Electronics (+5.9% organic); Consumer segment organic sales fell 2.1%.
Net income rose 29% y/y to $933M, tracking the same special-item dollar swings (Solventum stake value, lower PFAS/litigation costs) disclosed in the special-items table that lifted GAAP EPS.

Management cited mid-single-digit organic growth, ~25% adjusted operating margin, and double-digit adjusted EPS growth from strategic-priority execution, and raised FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $8.80-$8.95 from $8.50-$8.70 on strong first-half performance.
